name: Contracts Clerk
description: A desk, a stamp and a clerk who never sleeps. Switches on the Contracts Clerk: it accepts fitting offers for you and keeps 6% of what those jobs earn.

name: Reading Room Library Card
description: The Ministry library lends out its journals, with a fine for returning them late. Research points earned +10%.

name: Preferred Vendor Stamp
description: Your invoices go to the top of the pile, in a pink folder. Contract payouts +5%.

name: Double-Entry Ledger Reform
description: Every cruzeiro is now counted twice, which saves money somehow. Facility upkeep -8%.

name: Ministry Liaison Desk
description: A brass nameplate and a standing lunch reservation at the Ministry. Contract payouts +4%.

name: Procurement Committee
description: Three clerks, one stamp, and a joint discount on everything. Facility upkeep -7%.

name: Grand Ministry Concordat
description: The Minister himself signs. The pen is on a chain. Contract payouts +6%. Research points earned +5%.

name: Batch Scheduler Cards
description: A better deck of punch cards for the job queue. Contract payouts +3%.

name: Rear-Door Cabinet Drawings
description: Blueprints for a hinged heat exchanger on the cabinet door. Unlocks the Mk.III Rear-Door Air Cabinet: 32 PFLOPS at 55 kW.

name: Tape Silo Engineering
description: A gantry arm, ten thousand reels and a very long queue. Unlocks the Tape Silo Array: 8,000 TB at 30 kW.

name: Hot-Aisle Containment Cabinets
description: Ducted exhaust and curtains of fireproof canvas. Unlocks the Mk.IV Hot-Aisle Air Cabinet: 52 PFLOPS at 70 kW.

name: Cold-Plate Generation III
description: Copper plates milled to the thousandth of an inch, 160 kW per cabinet. Unlocks the Mk.III Cold-Plate Compute Cabinet: 230 PFLOPS at 160 kW.

name: Inference Accelerator Foundry
description: Fixed-function cards cast in a Ministry-approved foundry. Unlocks the Inference Accelerator Cabinet: 54 PFLOPS at 36 kW.

name: Manifold Blade Architecture
description: Rack-scale blades that slide into brass manifolds like cartridges. Unlocks the Mk.IV Manifold Blade Cabinet: 420 PFLOPS at 240 kW.

name: Desk Fan Standardisation
description: One model of zip-tie, one model of fan. The Ministry approves. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%.

name: Rear-Door Exchanger Patent
description: A chilled-water coil on a hinge, licensed from a small workshop. Unlocks the Rear-Door Air Handler.

name: Chilled-Water Loop Theory
description: Pumps, valves and a chalkboard full of Greek letters. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%.

name: High-Capacity Air Handling
description: A fan wall the size of a cinema screen. Unlocks the High-Capacity Air Handler.

name: Cooling Tower Hydraulics
description: A tower, a basin, and the permission to steam. Unlocks the Cooling-Tower Chiller. Unlocks the Industrial Coolant Manifold.

name: Dielectric Fluid Handbook
description: How to pour, drain and not drink the oil. Unlocks the Mk.I Dielectric Bath Cabinet: 300 PFLOPS at 180 kW.

name: Adiabatic Free Cooling
description: Evaporate the loop in the open air and let the sky have the heat. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%. Unlocks the Adiabatic Free-Cooling Chiller.

name: Two-Phase Immersion Doctrine
description: Boiling fluid and a condenser coil. Do not look into the vat. Rack failure rate -5%. Unlocks the Mk.II Two-Phase Immersion Vat: 560 PFLOPS at 300 kW.

name: Surge Protector Memorandum
description: Fuses, in writing, on every circuit. Rack failure rate -5%.

name: Off-Peak Tariff Petition
description: Thirty-two signatures and a plea to the Utility Board. Grid energy price -5%.

name: High-Voltage Substation Licence
description: A licence to import more electricity than strictly sensible. Unlocks the Substation Intake Hall.

name: Flywheel Rotor Patent
description: A brass rotor that stores a minute of the city in a second. Unlocks the Flywheel Rotor Bank.

name: Gas Turbine Concession
description: A pipeline tap and a turbine that sings. Grid energy price -3%. Unlocks the Gas Turbine Set No. 2.

name: Accumulator Hall Charter
description: Permission to keep a thousand jars of acid in one room. Unlocks the Accumulator Hall.

name: Transmission Feeder Treaty
description: A private line to the national grid, ratified in three languages. Grid energy price -5%. Unlocks the Transmission Feeder Annex.

name: Pit Crew Handbook
description: How to swap a GPU tray in under a minute, with a stopwatch. Bot repairs 15% faster.

name: Brass Gearing for Automatons
description: Faster gears and a louder whirr. Bot speed +10%.

name: Aerial Surveyor Drones
description: Clockwork rotors that skip the lift entirely. Unlocks the Surveyor Drone (flies between floors, 0.5 tiles per tick).

name: Central Stores Warehousing
description: Shelves, ledgers and a very patient storekeeper. Unlocks the Central Stores Warehouse.

name: Pantograph Fast Charging
description: Twenty-five kilowatts in a pantograph arm. Unlocks the Pantograph Fast-Charge Bay.

name: Heavy Lifter Chassis
description: A broad-shouldered automaton with room for three spare parts. Unlocks the Heavy Lifter Automaton (carries 3 spare parts per trip).

name: Autonomous Maintenance Corps
description: A drilled and uniformed corps of mechanical staff. Bot repairs 10% faster. Bot speed +5%.

name: Form 9-B: Wetware Annex
description: A new annex off the plant room, with a drain in the floor and a brochure. Unlocks the Organoid Incubator Cabinet and the Nutrient Medium Works, and lets you lay nutrient pipe like coolant.

name: Sterile Protocols
description: Boots, bleach and a laminated chart of when to use each. Unlocks the Sterile Bay.

name: Quarantine Doctrine
description: Doors that close behind you whether or not you have finished. Unlocks the Quarantine Lock.

name: Culling Licence
description: A permit with a very small print run. Unlocks the Culling Room.

name: DNA Archive Charter
description: Storage that grows its own shelves. Unlocks the DNA Vault: 16,000 TB per cabinet.

name: Bio-Reactor Permit
description: Power from fermentation, under licence 41-C. Unlocks the Bio-Reactor: 500 kW for 14 units of nutrient medium a tick.

name: Neural Pit Dossier
description: Forty pages, none of them dated. Unlocks the Neural Pit: 460 PFLOPS per vat.

name: Tissue Scaffolds
description: Lattices that teach the tissue where to stay. Rack failure rate -7%.

name: Register of Assets
description: Everything the Ministry now owns, in your building, in an index. Contract payouts +6%.

name: Works Foreman
description: A hard hat, a clipboard and a licence to requisition. Switches on the Works Foreman: once ordered, it builds racks, cooling and spare power where the Ministry's forms say you are short, at most 1 facility per game-hour.

name: Standing Orders Binder
description: A ring binder of stamped instructions that the bots have, against expectations, begun to read. Bot walking and flying speed +8%.

name: Form 11-S: Solar Skin Charter
description: The sun is declared a public utility, provided it files. Unlocks the Photovoltaic Skin Panels: 150 kW at noon on a clear day, nothing at night.

name: Wind Mast Permit
description: A permit to harvest the draught, countersigned by the draught. Unlocks the Vertical-Axis Wind Mast: up to 300 kW, on the third floor or above.

name: District Heat Accord
description: Your waste heat is formally recognised as waste, and therefore saleable. Unlocks the District-Heat Exchanger: 400 kW of heat sold at $3 a kWh.

name: Algae Cultivation Licence
description: A licence to grow, on the outside of the building, what the Ministry would prefer not to grow on the inside. Unlocks the Algae Façade: 160 carbon credits a day.

name: Neuromorphic Punch Cards
description: Cards that fire only when there is something to say, a rarity in a ministry. Unlocks the Neuromorphic Spiking Cabinet: 22 PFLOPS from 12 kW.

name: Canopy Array Dossier
description: Forty pages of load calculations and one of apology to the pigeons. Unlocks the Rooftop Photovoltaic Canopy: 420 kW at noon on a clear day.

name: Heat Pipeline Franchise
description: An exclusive right to warm the baths, the school and the cafeteria. Unlocks the Municipal Heat Pipeline: 1,600 kW of heat sold at $3 a kWh.

name: Carbon Capture Dossier
description: A bound volume proving that the carbon you remove is carbon that was there. Unlocks the Carbon Capture Stack: 1,100 carbon credits a day.

name: Green Ledger
description: Every kilowatt-hour is entered in green ink, which the grid operator finds reassuring and the accountants find expensive. Grid energy price -8%.

name: Photonic Bench Dossier
description: A bench, a lens and a very long form. Unlocks the Photonic Interconnect Cabinet: 330 PFLOPS from 40 kW.

name: Cryo Core Dossier
description: A refrigeration schematic with a margin note reading "colder". Unlocks the Cryo Core Cooler: 3,000 kW of heat removed at a COP of 16.

name: Form S-3: Continuity of Service
description: A form certifying that the process which began is the process which ends. Unlocks the Continuity Monitor: 800 kW and 400 kWh of ride-through.

name: Backup Vault Charter
description: A charter to keep, in cold storage, everything that should not be lost and some things that should. Unlocks the Backup Vault: 20,000 TB.

name: Mind Lattice Dossier
description: A forty-page specification of a rack that would prefer to be called a resident. Unlocks the Mind Lattice Cabinet: 640 PFLOPS from 220 kW.

name: Register of Identities
description: An index of every hosted process, each in the first person. Contract payouts +6%.

name: Continuity Doctrine
description: The policy that no process is ever finished, only filed. Rack failure rate -8%.
